hero.title:
Smart energy and
safety command center
hero.subtitle: Connect solar, electric meters, water, air, and CCTV across every site you operate — live monitoring, instant alerts, end-to-end billing in one place.

solar.title: Solar Monitoring
solar.desc: Auto-sync with SolarEdge and SolisCloud — peak/off-peak overview, per-inverter telemetry, alerts when an inverter goes offline.

electric.title: Electric Meter & Billing
electric.desc: Automated meter reads with PDF/Excel bill generation aligned to PEA/MEA tariffs, including on-peak/off-peak and FT adjustments.

water.title: Water Meter
water.desc: Per-site water usage dashboard with daily, monthly, and quarterly readings.

air.title: Air Quality
air.desc: PM2.5, PM10, CO2, and TVOC, paired with outdoor temperature and humidity from Open-Meteo.

facerec.title: Face & License Plate
facerec.desc: Detect faces and plates from on-site cameras with a live SSE event stream.

alert.title: Centralized Alerts
alert.desc: All device events in one feed, filterable by severity and site — never miss a critical event.

about.title: About BPS
about.lead: Built for organizations operating many sites across the country.
about.body: BPS Command Center unifies data from multi-vendor IoT devices — inverters, meters, water, air, and CCTV — into a single, simple console. With user and site management plus PDPA-aware billing built in.
